subject: Discovery recap — procurement readiness & invoice sample request
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Baxter <anna@cloudscale.com>
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai, priyom.das@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Discovery recap — procurement readiness & invoice sample request

Hi Anna —

Thanks again for the demo this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

- Procurement path: you mentioned CloudScale prefers a PO routed through Marco in Procurement; key question is whether card is ever used for smaller pilots.
- Billing details we need from your side to prep the first invoice: billing name/attention, full billing address, VAT/tax ID (if applicable), and preferred invoice format (PDF vs structured XLSX).
- Net terms: you suggested evaluating net-30 vs net-45 depending on internal approvals; can Marco confirm target terms?
- Marketplace: you said there’s internal interest in evaluating the AWS Marketplace option later; for now we should proceed on direct-contract path unless Procurement asks otherwise.

Could you please loop in Marco (procurement@cloudscale.com) and share CloudScale’s invoice template (if you have one) and any procurement intake form? I’ll send our W-9 and a sample invoice template for your finance team to review.

Next steps:
1) Marco to confirm PO cadence and net terms, and send any required fields or a procurement checklist (CC’d).
2) I’ll attach an invoice sample and W-9 by EOD.
3) We’ll hold on Marketplace kick-off until procurement confirms preferred commercial path.

Appreciate it —

Jonas Weber
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192
[attachment: none]

From: Anna Baxter <anna@cloudscale.com>

Thanks Jonas —

Quick answers while I loop Marco in: we will use PO for anything > $5k; for small pilots under $5k we sometimes pay by card, but Procurement prefers POs for production contracts. Marco will confirm whether CloudScale can do net-30 or needs net-45 based on current vendor cadence.

I attached our procurement requirements doc with fields they usually require (line items, PO number, remit-to address, tax ID). Marco — tagging you to confirm: can you send the PO template you prefer and confirm target net terms for a first-year pilot?

Anna Baxter
Director, Platform Partnerships | CloudScale Inc.
anna@cloudscale.com | +1 (646) 555-2234

Jonas — looping finance/ops advisors. Replied below from Anna. Action items for us: 

- Send W-9 and an editable invoice template (XLSX) that includes: PO number, project code, line-item breakdown, and tax fields.
- Priyom: can you validate whether Redwood can accept net-45 for first-year pilots and what the default SLA is for invoice processing? If net-45 adds credit risk we should propose net-30 with payment milestone.
- Lauren: please prep a one-page billing SOP we can share that lists required fields and our remit-to details.

If Procurement prefers a marketplace purchase, we should note the different tax treatment and longer onboarding time (marketplace registrations often take 2–3 weeks). For now, we keep the primary path as direct PO.

Thanks —
Rishi
VP, Commercial | Redwood Inference

Anna / Marco —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Attaching our invoice sample (invoice_template_v1.xlsx) and our W-9. A few clarifications to make Marco’s job easier: 

- Billing / remit-to: "Redwood Inference, Inc."
  Redwood Inference
  Attn: Accounts Receivable
  1217 Market St, Suite 230
  San Francisco, CA 94103

- Required fields on our invoices: PO number, invoice date, invoice number, line-item description, quantity, unit price, subtotal, tax amount, total due, billing contact and email for remittance confirmation. The attached XLSX provides these fields as columns.
- Tax/VAT: US customers should provide a US tax ID if applicable; international buyers should provide VAT ID and indicate reverse-charge if relevant. If CloudScale has a VAT ID, please paste it into the "Tax ID" cell of the attached template.
- Net terms: we can accept net-45 for a first pilot on approval from Finance; Rishi/Finance will confirm by EOD. If Procurement needs an interim payment milestone we can structure a 50/50 split.

Next steps: 
1) Marco to share preferred PO template and confirm net terms & expected PO date.
2) Marco/Anna to confirm billing address and VAT/tax ID and return a short confirmation email.
3) We’ll proceed to issue an initial invoice once PO is received or card details provided for pilot.

Attachments: invoice_template_v1.xlsx, Redwood_W9.pdf

Appreciate it —

Jonas Weber
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
